convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in MA indicators with simple crossover entry/exit rules, fixed or pip-based SL/TP, and straightforward position sizing. No external libraries or custom indicators required.

other_exits: Opposite signal closes current position before opening new one in reverse direction

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Negative Lot value = fixed lot size (absolute value used); Positive Lot value = fraction of free margin for position sizing

custom_logic_notes: EA title 'N seconds N points' suggests configurable time and pip parameters. The digit adjustment logic multiplies SL and TP by 10 when broker uses 5-digit pricing (_Digits==5 or _Point<0.001). Position sizing is dual-mode: negative input = fixed lots, positive input = margin fraction. Opposite signal triggers close of existing position before new entry. Entry signals use previous completed bar values (shift 1) to avoid repainting.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward MA crossover strategy. Use ta-lib or pandas for SMA calculation. Digit adjustment logic translates to pip vs point distinction in Python - ensure SL/TP are in price units not points. The conditional lot sizing (negative=fixed, positive=margin fraction) needs explicit branching. New bar detection uses bar time comparison - implement via timestamp tracking. Entry on previous bar values (shift=1) avoids lookahead bias in backtesting.
